question: Can you tell me about a former name of the nearest university from Veterans Memorial Museum, Branson, MO?
sql:
SELECT * FROM pois
WHERE amenity = 'university'
ORDER BY  geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-93.241187 36.639687)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

answers.multi_source_answer: Fourth District Normal School (1905–1919)  Southwest Missouri State Teachers College (1919–1945) Southwest Missouri State College (1945–1972) Southwest Missouri State University (1972–2005)
answers.multi_source_long_answer: Missouri State University Former names: Fourth District Normal School (1905–1919)  Southwest Missouri State Teachers College (1919–1945) Southwest Missouri State College (1945–1972) Southwest Missouri State University (1972–2005)
